items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Hank, he came up to see me. He says, 'Got an idea. How would you like to work with Dollar Brand?' ... So he says, 'He would like to make an album with you.' So I says, 'Yeah, it's all right with me'

ctx.x: Hank's. And Dollar Brand wanted to do it. You see, you know -- all right, this record here, this record here, would you believe this record is a hit in South Africa?
